versions.summary: Baseline: SupportPortal automation running on ECS Production at release r20260911-42f2f11.

sections.title: Notes
items: Version 1.0.0 is the baseline assigned to the current Production release; earlier history is not versioned.
Machine-readable deployment records (release id, commit, image digests, included PRs, deploy time) are read live from the Production database in the Deployment records view.

sections.title: Included capabilities
items: Account case automation (Fraud Account, Account Suspension, Detailed Invoice, Enablement, Quota) on ECS Production with routed Persona replies.
Engineer Slack collaboration loop with Hermes investigation review, thread-bound summons, and publication gates.
Ticket-centric read-only dashboard and Admin console under /automation/production/.
CodeBuild release pipeline with immutable images, prompt-release gates, and deploy-time release-note records.
